name: Nomcebo
face: Young Swati girl with warm deep-brown skin, a round face, dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright open smile.
clothing: Traditional emáhiya: a red and white patterned wrap skirt with a black and yellow beaded waistband, a matching red-and-white top with short sleeves, and many colorful bead necklaces layered on the chest. Bare feet or simple brown sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
dominantColor: Red, white, black, and yellow beads
distinctiveFeatures: Short dark hair with a neat part, stacked colorful bead necklaces that rest on her chest, and the red-and-white emáhiya wrap.
